sermons.title: Sermon 20 | The Carnal Mind Enmity Against God

scripture.verse: The carnal mind is enmity against God
Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.

sermons.title: Sermon 22 | A Caution to the Presumptuous

scripture.verse: Let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.

sermons.title: Sermon 23 | Thoughts on the Last Battle

scripture.verse: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law. But, thanks be unto God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.

sermons.title: Sermon 25 | The Hope of Future Bliss

scripture.verse: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

sermons.title: Sermon 26 | The Two Effects of the Gospel

scripture.verse: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
His name shall endure for ever.
And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.
